comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible site key used on Admin Panel forms.
modal: The public (website) key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible, used to render the widget on protected admin forms. Stored encrypted.

comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible secret key used to verify admin responses.
modal: The private (secret) key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible, used server-side to verify responses from protected admin forms. Stored encrypted.

comment: Where the invisible reCAPTCHA badge is placed on admin forms.
modal: Selects the on-screen position of the reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible badge shown on protected admin forms.

comment: The colour theme of the reCAPTCHA badge on admin forms.
modal: Selects the colour theme used for the reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible badge on protected admin forms.

comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible site key used on storefront forms.
modal: The public (website) key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible, used to render the widget on protected storefront forms. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible secret key used to verify storefront responses.
modal: The private (secret) key issued by Google for reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible, used server-side to verify responses from protected storefront forms. Stored encrypted and can be set per website.

comment: Where the invisible reCAPTCHA badge is placed on storefront forms.
modal: Selects the on-screen position of the reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible badge shown on protected storefront forms. Can be set per website.

comment: The colour theme of the reCAPTCHA badge on storefront forms.
modal: Selects the colour theme used for the reCAPTCHA v2 Invisible badge on protected storefront forms. Can be set per website.
